name: After § 25
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 25a. Welcomes the International Court of Justice (ICJ) Case 192 – Application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel), as well as the Advisory opinion of the ICJ on the legal consequences arising from Israel’s policies and practices in the Occupied Palestinian Territory (OPT), including East Jerusalem, and from the illegality of Israel’s continued presence in the OPT; calls on the Member States to support the ICJ and demand that Israel immediately comply with the legally binding orders issued by the ICJ;
